title: Umwanzi w'umuriro
intro: Mu minsi ya mbere y'ihishurirwa, umuntu yagaragaye nk'urwanya ukuri cyane. Yahawe ubutunzi n'icyubahiro, uyu muntu yahisemo kwirata kuruta ubuyobozi, maze inkuru yabo iba umuburo ukomeye mu mirongo ya nyuma ya sura.
clues: Nabaga mu mujyi umwe n'Umuhanuzi, kandi nari mu bo mu muryango we wa hafi, nyamara ishema ryanjye ryatumye ntamenya ukuri.
Nari mfite ubutunzi bwinshi n'imitungo myinshi, kandi nibwiraga ko umutungo wanjye uzahora unyirinda.
Ubwo butumwa bwahishurwaga, nabusetse ku mugaragaro maze ndahindukira, nibwira ko ndi hejuru y'abizera.
Urwango rwanjye rwari ruzwi cyane ku buryo sura ya Korowani yanyivuganye, inyita izina abandi bari banzi.
Naburiwe ko ubutunzi bwanjye n'ibyo ntunze bitazangirira akamaro, kandi nzajugunywa mu muriro ugurumana.
Nzwi nka se w'umuriro, kandi umugore wanjye azatwara inkwi afite umugozi w'imikindo mu ijosi.
